svg.title: Workflow 1: Every call answered
svg.text: Overflow, evenings and weekends: the assistant answers, books and texts; people get anything urgent.
or out of hours: BT diverts
Checks postcode, offers survey slots from ServiceM8, books it
Safety line, then rings the on-call electrician
Reads the booked time from ServiceM8
Takes a message for a named person
Text within 1 min: “Sorry we missed you…”
13-week results window: 430 calls handled by the assistant (33.1%), 26 urgent calls put through to a person, 13 not understood and called back within 15 minutes.
Asked for a person to call back (21)
Not understood → called back in 15 min (13)
Give a price, or a time not in the diary
Takes a message for a person if asked
Texts the caller what was agreed
Assistant down: BT divert goes to
Off switch: one setting on the BT line
Retell AI on a Twilio UK number
